annotations.title: Grade security headers for up to 10 sites

description: Grade security headers for up to 10 sites — Fleet security-header audit: grade up to 10 sites or domains A-F on HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and COOP in one call. Returns per-site grade, score and missing headers, the fleet grade and average, weakest and strongest site, headers most commonly missing across the fleet, and a prioritised action list. Pass ?urls= (comma-separated). Price: $0.05 USDC (Base, via x402).
